title: Classic Middle Eastern Shawarma
description: A flavorful and aromatic street food-style shawarma recipe featuring thinly sliced lamb and a blend of Middle Eastern spices.

ingredients.name: Middle Eastern Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern or Mediterranean markets

instructions: Preheat the grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, mix together the Middle Eastern spice blend, garlic, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Place the lamb shoulder in a large zip-top plastic bag or a shallow dish. Pour the spice mixture over the lamb, turning to coat evenly.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Remove the lamb from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Season the lamb with salt. Place the lamb on a rimmed baking sheet or a wire rack set over a rimmed baking sheet.
Roast the lamb in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the lamb to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing thinly against the grain.
Warm the pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for a few minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by slicing the lamb into thin strips and serving it in the pita breads with tzatziki sauce, chopped cucumber, and fresh parsley.
